function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on whether you’re looking for something local or something that can be delivered right to your door: | Option | What it offers | How to order | |--------|----------------|--------------| | **Local bakeries** | Fresh, custom‑made cakes, often with a personal touch. | Search “cake shop near me” on Google Maps or Yelp, call the bakery, or visit their website. Many local shops now accept online orders via their own site or through platforms like **Etsy** or **Shopify**. | | **National cake delivery services** | Nationwide delivery, a wide range of flavors, and sometimes same‑day service. | • **Goldbelly** – delivers specialty cakes from famous bakeries across the U.S.
• **Cake Delivery** – offers a variety of cakes and custom orders. | | **Online marketplaces** | A mix of local and national options, plus reviews and ratings. | • **Etsy** – find local artisans who ship nationwide.
• **Amazon** – has a selection of pre‑made cakes that can be shipped. | | **Food‑delivery apps** | Quick delivery from restaurants or bakeries that partner with them. | • **Uber Eats** – many bakeries list their cakes here.
• **DoorDash** – similar to Uber Eats, often includes local bakeries.
• **Grubhub** – check for local cake shops. | | **Specialty cake shops** | Custom designs, themed cakes, and premium ingredients. | • **Magnolia Bakery** – known for classic American cakes.
• **Baker & Spice** – offers organic, gluten‑free options.
• **The Cake Shop** – specializes in wedding cakes and custom orders. | | **DIY kits** | If you want to bake at home but still get a professional look. | • **Amazon** – “cake baking kit” or “custom cake kit.”
• **Etsy** – handmade cake kits with unique designs. | ### Quick steps to place an order 1. **Decide on the type of cake** (birthday, wedding, custom design, dietary restrictions, etc.). 2. **Choose a provider** from the table above that fits your budget and delivery needs. 3. **Visit their website or app** and select the cake size, flavor, and any custom text or decorations. 4. **Enter your delivery address** and choose a delivery window if available. 5. **Pay securely** using credit card, PayPal, or other accepted methods. 6. **Confirm the order** and keep the confirmation email or receipt handy. If you let me know your city or zip code, I can pull up specific local bakeries and their contact details for you!
